note: Anonymous GET. Pond Protocol V1 declaration -- no bearer token or protocol-version header required.

metadata.name: FSignal
metadata.short_description: Detect founder-announced YC/Speedrun companies before official confirmation.
metadata.description: Persistent launch intelligence for GTM teams. FSignal cross-checks founder announcements against official accelerator directories, sends Slack alerts for pre-directory signals, and measures Ghost-to-Confirmed lead time.
metadata.key_features:
• YC Directory and Speedrun monitoring
  • X and LinkedIn founder-signal detection
  • Persistent deduplication and alert retry
  • Ghost-to-Confirmed reconciliation with lead-time measurement
  • Explainable confidence, evidence, and GTM priority scoring
  • Persistent signal timeline and source health monitoring
metadata.use_cases: Find newly accepted accelerator founders early enough for outbound, pipeline discovery, and time-sensitive GTM outreach.
metadata.setup_instructions: Deploy this server over HTTPS, configure POND_ACCESS_KEY and source credentials, then use the public Server Base URL when publishing the Agent in Pond.

actions.name: Scan now
actions.description: Use when the user wants FSignal to immediately check all configured launch-monitor sources for new signals.

actions.name: Get status
actions.description: Use when the user wants current source health, monitoring status, signal counts, or alert-delivery state.

actions.name: List ghosts
actions.description: Use when the user wants founder-announced YC or Speedrun signals that are not yet matched to an official directory entry.

limit.description: Maximum number of current ghost signals to return.

actions.name: Get signal timeline
actions.description: Use when the user wants the auditable detection, alert, and confirmation history for a specific signal.

signal_id.description: Persistent social signal ID returned by list_ghosts or the API.
